## Problem Statement

<!-- What problem are you trying to solve? Describe it clearly and without assuming the solution.

## Proposed Solution

<!-- Describe the feature you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- Have you considered any other approaches or workarounds? Why didn't they satisfy the need? -->

## Who Does This Help?

<!-- Who is the primary audience for this feature?

## Prior Art / References

<!-- Are there other tools or products that handle this well? Links welcome. -->

<!-- Anything else the maintainers should know? Edge cases, dependencies, constraints? -->
